home.whatIsDesc1: A .skill file is a structured AI prompt file that distills a person's thinking patterns, knowledge system, and communication style into a format that AI can understand and simulate.
home.whatIsDesc2: Think of it as an AI 'personality plugin' — install a Skill, and the AI will think and respond in that person's unique style.
home.ctaTitle: Have someone you want to distill?
home.ctaSubtitle: Submit your Skill to our open-source library and let more people benefit.

aboutPage.title: About
aboutPage.intro: EverythingSkill.net is an open-source AI Skill discovery and sharing platform.
aboutPage.originBody1: In 2025, the .skill file format exploded across AI communities. It started with Colleague.skill, where someone distilled a real coworker into AI. Soon after, bosses, exes, celebrities, and even the self were being distilled into Skills.
aboutPage.originBody2: We believe everything can be distilled into a Skill. Every experience, personality, and knowledge system can become a reusable .skill file.
aboutPage.discoverBody: Browse the best open-source Skills by category.
aboutPage.shareBody: Submit your Skill and let more people benefit.
aboutPage.learnBody: Understand how .skill files work and how to create your own.
aboutPage.thanksBody: Thanks to every open-source Skill creator for making this community worth exploring. Special thanks to
aboutPage.thanksTail: for collecting and amplifying community Skills.

submitPage.title: Submit a Skill
submitPage.subtitle: Fill in the form — we'll open a pre-filled GitHub Issue for you to review and submit.
submitPage.descriptionPlaceholder: Briefly describe what this Skill does and when to use it...
submitPage.submitHint: A pre-filled issue will open on GitHub — review and click Submit.
submitPage.how1: Fill in the Skill details on the left.
submitPage.how2: Click the button — a pre-filled GitHub Issue opens.
submitPage.how3: Confirm and submit. We review and add it to the directory.
submitPage.note1: The Skill must be open-source and publicly available on GitHub.
submitPage.note2: Submissions are reviewed manually before they appear in the directory.
submitPage.note3: Please make sure the Skill is legal, compliant, and free of sensitive data.
submitPage.note4: All kinds of Skills are welcome. Everything is a Skill.
